about.title: Professional profile
paragraphs: I am a computer engineer focused on backend development and API design. I enjoy building services with clear architecture, well-considered security and tests that make them easier to evolve.

I have worked with Java, Spring Boot and Node.js, applying JWT authentication, separation of concerns and automated testing. I have also built a cross-platform application for Android and iOS together with its REST API, started during my internship and extended as my final degree project, with over 70% of the code shared between both platforms.
I want to keep growing as a backend engineer, take part in technical decisions and help build software that is easy to maintain and improve.
